components.label: Description
components.quote: Typhim Vi®, Typhoid Vi Polysaccharide Vaccine, produced by Sanofi Winthrop Industrie , for intramuscular use, is a sterile solution containing the cell surface Vi polysaccharide extracted from Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi, S typhi Ty2 strain.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Casein derived raw materials are used early in manufacturing during the fermentation process.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Each 0.5 mL dose may contain residual amounts of formaldehyde (not more than 100 mcg) used for the inactivation of the bacterial culture.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Phenol, 0.25%, is added as a preservative. The vaccine contains residual polydimethylsiloxane or fatty-acid ester-based antifoam.

allergens.quote: The vial stopper and the plunger stopper of the syringe are not made with natural rubber latex.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Typhim Vi vaccine is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to any component of this vaccine.
